stem:
Yash must write $59000$ in scientific notation, with coefficient $x$ satisfying $1 \le x < 10$.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: The exponent $4$ is what creates the coefficient $5.9$.
Also allow $0.59 \times 10^{5}$ under the same scientific-notation rule.

teacher.key_rationale: Scientific notation needs 1 ≤ x < 10, so 5.9×10^4. Coefficient 59 omits that bound; reversing cause; or allowing 0.59 stretches past the coefficient rule.
